body.research_scope: Compare introductory financial-risk curricula and identify trustworthy sources for the approved outcomes, with deep grounding for Nature of Financial Risk.

competitor_findings.audience: Finance professionals preparing for professional risk-management practice.
competitor_findings.structure_summary: Progresses from foundations and quantitative analysis into market, credit, operational, liquidity, and investment risk.
competitor_findings.differentiation_opportunity: Use shorter concept-to-case loops and explicit human selection of source and asset plans.

competitor_findings.offering: Nature of Financial Risk reference materials
competitor_findings.audience: Postgraduate learners encountering financial risk categories for the first time.
competitor_findings.structure_summary: Combines concept exposition, objectives, summary, case, personality, fact, assessment, activities, and resources.
competitor_findings.differentiation_opportunity: Generate only the assets selected for each subtopic and tune depth independently.

source_candidates.title: Risk, Uncertainty, and Profit
source_candidates.trust_notes: Foundational primary text for the risk-versus-uncertainty distinction.
source_candidates.relevance: Supports measurable risk, uncertainty, and the limits of quantitative management.

source_candidates.title: Principles for the Management of Credit Risk
source_candidates.relevance: Supports credit-risk definitions, exposure examples, and interaction with other risks.

source_candidates.title: Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision
source_candidates.relevance: Supports liquidity-risk definitions, funding stress, and risk interaction.

source_candidates.title: Basel market-risk and operational-risk frameworks
source_candidates.relevance: Supports market-risk and operational-risk definitions and examples.

source_candidates.title: The Financial Crisis Inquiry Report
source_candidates.trust_notes: Official investigation with detailed case evidence.
source_candidates.relevance: Supports the Lehman Brothers layered-risk case.

source_candidates.title: Rise of the chief risk officer
source_candidates.trust_notes: Useful contemporaneous industry source; use only for the narrow history claim.
source_candidates.relevance: Supports the emergence of the CRO role and integrated risk oversight.

source_candidates.title: Risk-management practitioner interview
source_candidates.trust_notes: Requires expert identification, consent, and transcript review.
source_candidates.relevance: Could add current practitioner judgment to the governance module.

source_candidates.title: Anonymous risk explainer
source_candidates.trust_notes: Rejected by the human reviewer because authorship and evidence are unclear.
source_candidates.relevance: Overlaps with approved definitions but adds no trustworthy evidence.
